The '''Divine Shadow Staff''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[The Greater Darkness]], a [[boss]] in [[Ravenheart Gloom]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10 
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) 
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 
:[[Health]] +60

== Skin == 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the non-unique [[Shadow Staff]]. 

==Replica==

**[[Imperial Staff|Imperial Divine Staff]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]

*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]

**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]

==Unique counterparts==
*The [[Divine Favor]] version of [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Kerrsh's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
*[[Banor's Sacred Branch]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Holy damage]] and requires [[Protection Prayers]].
